units.title: Module 1 Getting to know you — Hello! 见面问候

knowledge_points.name: 问候语 Hello / Hi / Good morning
knowledge_points.description: 掌握不同时段的问候语。

knowledge_points.name: 道别 Goodbye / Good night
knowledge_points.description: 掌握告别用语。

units.title: Module 1 Getting to know you — How are you? 你好吗

knowledge_points.name: 询问身体与情绪 How are you?
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 How are you? 及回答。

knowledge_points.name: 情绪表达 happy / sad / tired
knowledge_points.description: 会用英语表达基本情绪。

units.title: Module 1 Getting to know you — Are you Kitty? 你是谁

knowledge_points.name: 一般疑问句 Are you…?
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 Are you…? 及其回答。

knowledge_points.name: 询问姓名 What's your name?
knowledge_points.description: 掌握询问与回答姓名。

units.title: Module 2 My family, my friends and me — My friends 我的朋友

knowledge_points.name: 介绍朋友 This is my friend…
knowledge_points.description: 会把朋友介绍给别人。

knowledge_points.name: 人称代词 he / she
knowledge_points.description: 会按性别选用 he / she。

units.title: Module 2 My family, my friends and me — My family 我的家庭

knowledge_points.name: 家庭成员 father / mother / brother / sister
knowledge_points.description: 掌握家庭成员的英文表达。

knowledge_points.name: 介绍家人 This is my…
knowledge_points.description: 会向别人介绍自己的家人。

units.title: Module 2 My family, my friends and me — Me 我自己

knowledge_points.name: 自我介绍 I'm…
knowledge_points.description: 会用 I'm… 介绍姓名与身份。

knowledge_points.name: 表达年龄 I'm nine (years old)
knowledge_points.description: 会用英语表达年龄。

units.title: Module 3 Places and activities — In the classroom 在教室里

knowledge_points.name: 教室词汇 classroom / desk / chair / blackboard
knowledge_points.description: 掌握教室物品词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 方位介词 on / in / under
knowledge_points.description: 会用介词表达位置。

units.title: Module 3 Places and activities — At the fruit shop 在水果店

knowledge_points.name: 水果词汇 apple / banana / orange / pear
knowledge_points.description: 掌握常见水果词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 表达喜好 I like…
knowledge_points.description: 会用英语表达喜欢的水果。

units.title: Module 3 Places and activities — In my room 在我的房间

knowledge_points.name: 房间物品 bed / table / lamp / toy
knowledge_points.description: 掌握房间物品词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 询问位置 Where's my…?
knowledge_points.description: 会用 Where's…? 询问位置。

units.title: Module 4 The world around us — Numbers 数字

knowledge_points.name: 数字 1-12 与 eleven / twelve
knowledge_points.description: 掌握 1-12 的英文表达。

knowledge_points.name: 询问数量 How many…?
knowledge_points.description: 会用 How many 询问数量。

units.title: Module 4 The world around us — Small animals 小动物

knowledge_points.name: 动物词汇 cat / dog / bird / rabbit / fish
knowledge_points.description: 掌握常见小动物词汇。

knowledge_points.name: 表达拥有 I have a…
knowledge_points.description: 会用 I have… 表达拥有。

units.title: Module 4 The world around us — The four seasons 四季

knowledge_points.name: 季节 spring / summer / autumn / winter
knowledge_points.description: 掌握四季的英文表达。

knowledge_points.name: 表达最喜欢 I like… best
knowledge_points.description: 会用 best 表达「最」。
